definitions.explanation: Describes the quality of having many different kinds or forms. Used for cultures, lifestyles, opinions, species, and other things with wide variety.

examples.japanese: {多様|たよう}な⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧。
⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多様|たよう}になってきた。
examples.english: Work styles have become more diverse.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多様|たよう}な⟦{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}→動植物：23782_doushokubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A diverse range of plants and animals inhabit this region, attracting researchers' attention.

notes:
{多様|たよう} is a na-adjective and noun describing variety and diversity.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {多様|たよう}な + noun
- Noun: {多様|たよう}{性|せい} (diversity)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多様|たよう}な⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧: diverse values
- {多様|たよう}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: varied opinions
- {多様|たよう}{性|せい}: diversity (very common compound)
- {多様|たよう}{化|か}: diversification
- ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧{多様|たよう}{性|せい}: biodiversity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧: emphasizes individual differences among items ("various, all sorts of")
- {多様|たよう}: emphasizes the overall quality of having variety ("diverse")
- ⟦{多彩|たさい}→多彩：12165_tasai⟧: emphasizes richness and colorfulness of variety
